history.summary: Efficient 980 sqft 3BR at Gem Residences (D12, Toa Payoh) priced at $1.85M / $1888 PSF — notably ~7% below the $2036 district median — in the $1.8M-2.5M deepest-liquidity band, near Braddell MRT. Appreciation is a modest 3.9%/yr but on a very reliable 188-transaction series; price discount and strong liquidity make this a solid value entry.
history.rating_rationale: Asking PSF $1888 is ~7% under the $2036.5 URA median on a deep 188-txn dataset — genuinely cheap for the project. Price $1.85M lands in the deepest buyer-pool band, 980 sqft 3BR is efficient and family-marketable, and Toa Payoh is a perennially liquid mature estate with NSL access. The modest 3.9%/yr appreciation is the main drag, but value + liquidity carry it.

590m to MRT is a 7-min walk, not doorstep

history.summary: Genuine value: a 3BR asking $1,887 psf in a large, liquid Toa Payoh project where recent comparable units transacted $2,000-2,260 psf, next to two MRT lines.
history.rating_rationale: This is the standout of the cohort. Asking $1,887 psf for a 980 sqft 3-bed is verifiably below recent transactions: the project's last-12-month average is ~$2,006 psf, with 1,055 sqft units transacting $2,228-2,264 psf (Apr 2026) and a Dec 2025 sale at $2,350,000 - so the -8.9% vs-cohort and -9.7% age-adjusted reads are corroborated by real, deep data (188 appreciation txns, 16 cohort txns). Unlike the thin-cohort names in this batch, the cheapness here is real and well-evidenced. Liquidity is excellent (578 units), and the location (Lorong 5 Toa Payoh, Braddell NS18 / Toa Payoh NS19 nearby, mature D12 RCR/OCR town) sits in the favorable forward-return band. Risks are modest: 99-yr lease and some negative MCST/security reviews. Value-led case justifies a Buy, capped at medium confidence because the model explains <10% of forward variance and the undercut, while real, is single-digit.
red_flags: 99-year leasehold (from ~2016) - lease decay is a long-run drag
Discount vs comps is single-digit (~9%), a cushion rather than a deep bargain
catalysts: Verified ~9% PSF discount to recent same-project transactions ($1,887 vs ~$2,006 avg, comps at $2,228-2,264 psf)
Deep liquidity: 578-unit project with 188 transactions - easy to price and exit
Braddell (NS18) and Toa Payoh (NS19) MRT access in a mature, well-amenitized D12 town
RCR/OCR location band with the strongest realized forward appreciation
